summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Chilean Material Fact via Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting approved a new share buyback program. The program authorizes repurchase of up to 5% of subscribed and paid shares, or 28,710,799,185 shares out of 574,215,983,709 total, over five years. The board sets minimum and maximum prices, may acquire on stock exchanges via pro rata systems or directly in the market up to 1% within 12 months, and can dispose of up to 1% without preferential offering. What to watch: execution pace and capital allocation signaling.
